visual_decision: Usable restrained preview ribbon; final combat readability and AAA approval pending
scope: Fixed paused art fixture; real Game first room, production hero A89, actual RuneCamera wide shot, deliberately reframed detail shot. Not live gameplay, timing QA or hardware performance evidence.
alpha: The source uses tip alpha .34 and base alpha .035, aged over .12 seconds. Ribbon remains translucent and does not blanket the torso/floor in these poses.
tint: The mint #8bd9cb additive ribbon appears pale mint/near-white against sunlit stone. Visible in detail, weak contrast at default gameplay distance.
depth: Actual source material keeps depth testing enabled, disables depth writes, and casts no shadow. Observed poses do not glow through the body; this is not a dedicated world-obstacle occlusion sweep.
readability: At .18s the detail view clearly separates blade and trailing translucent wedge. At .24s and default rear camera the broad blade/trail is more edge-on and subtle; still-image visibility alone cannot approve motion or multi-enemy readability.
recommendation: Retain as the restrained preview baseline if desired. Before final art approval, compare real-speed attacks against bright stone/dark body and enemy telegraphs; evaluate a slightly stronger distal mint edge rather than expanding blade/active window. Do not change gameplay reach or timing to improve VFX visibility.
